subject: Carebridge: discovery recap, integration constraints & proposed PoC plan
summary: Post-demo discovery recap: Carebridge needs a HIPAA-aware inference path with VPC/private deployment, <50ms p50 target for critical routing, SDKs in Python/Node, and a 6-week PoC with defined milestones. Customer requests SOC 2 evidence and an accelerated onboarding call on 2026-05-31. Internal owners and next steps assigned.
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Kendall <emily.kendall@carebridge.com>, Tom Hooper <tom.hooper@carebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Carebridge: discovery recap, integration constraints & proposed PoC plan

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Below is a concise recap from our call, plus a suggested PoC plan and owners so we can lock next steps. Please flag anything I mis-stated.

Key pain points you shared:
- Critical routing latency on triage flows (target p50 for critical requests: <50ms).
- Current on-prem inference is inconsistent; you want predictable latency and lower per-token cost vs current GPU ops.
- Data sensitivity: many requests will be PHI; solution must support private deployment or VPC egress controls.
- Integration effort: small engineering team (2 backend engineers), prefer Python SDK and Node for webhooks.

Current stack (as mentioned):
- Frontend: React; backend services in Node + Python on ECS (us-east-1).
- Existing model inference on-prem (custom GPU hosts) with batch queuing.
- Auth: internal OAuth + Okta.

Success criteria for PoC (you indicated):
1) Functional parity: responses match current quality for triage intents (fewer than 10% regression on core prompts).
2) Latency: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 200ms for single-turn triage requests under a 50 req/s sustained load.
3) Security/compliance: data never leaves your VPC for PHI flows (or is encrypted/TLS + KMS with customer-managed keys).
4) Cost visibility: token-level cost breakdown and guidance to hit target TCO.

Proposed 6-week PoC (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): NDA + SOC2 snapshot exchange, kickoff call and access prep. (owner: Emily / Aditya)
- Week 1: Private onboarding: deploy Redwood Private control plane in a test VPC, verify networking and Okta SSO. (owner: Soojin / Carebridge infra)
- Week 2: SDK integration: route a small set of triage requests via Python SDK; instrument tracing. (owner: Carebridge eng / Connor)
- Week 3: Model parity & quality evaluation using your prompt set; iterate model selection & prompt tuning. (owner: Carebridge product / Marissa)
- Week 4: Load testing for 50 req/s sustained, latency profiling, caching/batching tweaks. (owner: Soojin / Redwood infra)
- Week 5: Cost tuning (quantization, batching policy), run regression checks. (owner: Marissa / Aditya)
- Week 6: Review, decision meeting & next-step commercial conversation.

SDK / API compatibility notes:
- We will provide a Python SDK (async + sync) and a Node client. Both support streaming, function/tool calls, and token-level metrics.
- We can expose a private endpoint in your VPC and support customer-managed KMS for keying PHI flows.

Attachments attached to this thread: carebridge_integration_matrix.xlsx (integration checklist), redwood_poc_timeline.pdf (detailed week-by-week), soc2_snapshot_2026Q1.pdf (SOC2 evidence snapshot).

Next steps / asks from Carebridge:
- Confirm owners for Okta/infra access and an internal contact for sensitive-data boundary decisions.
- Share a small sample prompt set (non-PHI) for quality baselining.
- Confirm whether you want a hosted sandbox (redwood-hosted) or Private (VPC) as the default PoC mode.

Proposed meeting to kick off technical onboarding: Mon, 31 May 2026, 10:00am ET / 7:00am PT — I can send a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
(aditya_rao@redwood.ai)

From: Emily Kendall <emily.kendall@carebridge.com>

Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Carebridge: discovery recap, integration constraints & proposed PoC plan

Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. High level OK from our side; a few clarifications and constraints: 

- HIPAA / PHI: For any PHI flows we must keep data in our VPC or have HSM-backed keying. Hosted sandbox is fine for non-PHI triage tests, but the PoC should validate the VPC/private path early (ideally Week 1).
- Residency: everything must be in us-east-1 for the PoC and eventual production.
- Team bandwidth: two backend engineers (Raj + Lina) can spend 10-15 hours/week on the PoC. Please keep the integration footprint small.
- Success criteria: add a stability metric: <2% error rate (5xx) under sustained load.

We will:
- Share the non-PHI prompt set by Monday (attached as a Google Drive link when ready).
- Confirm infra owners for Okta & networking (Tom will be primary).

One ask: can Redwood provide a short one-page runbook for the VPC onboarding steps (IP ranges, subnets, firewall rules) before the kickoff so our infra team can pre-provision?

Emily
Sr. Product Manager | Carebridge Health
emily.kendall@carebridge.com
